title: To See Nature: A Window of Opportunity to Decrease the Risk of Depression and Anxiety
content: We read with great interest the recent meta-analysis evaluating the associations between viewing nature through windows and health outcomes published by Soga and Gaston (2025). The authors examined 28 studies and concluded that viewing nature through a window is associated with health benefits. This is an important and timely contribution to the growing field of nature and health research.
